review:
Forgotten is a ghost-story book slot. You return to your empty family home, find forgotten toys and a mysterious notebook, and head to a haunted attic for the bonus. It uses 10 paylines.

The bonus awards 10 free spins with expanding toy symbols. The bonus buy is especially flexible: you can buy the round with 1, 2, 4 or 8 expanding symbols, at increasing prices, letting you choose your risk level. Chance x2 doubles the odds of reaching the attic naturally. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 7,500x maximum and a strong 96.89% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 173 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
